finding.title: Dispatcher final wait4 kernel peak is recorded but ignored
finding.detail: complete_peak uses only observation.conservative_peak_after_receipt_serialization_bytes plus helper peak. The actual dispatcher terminal ru_maxrss is present only in the output receipt; a peak increase during subsequent observation/printing/exit can escape the external envelope check.
finding.required_fix: Include nonnegative delta between dispatcher terminal kernel peak and observation.peak_after_receipt_serialization_bytes in complete_peak before all stored-envelope/cap comparisons.

conditions: Successful pinned external launcher receipt plus successful pinned post-write observation are mandatory before finalizer/qualification.

Exceptions or external cancellation have no accepted external receipt; ROOT must stop and preserve unconfirmed-cleanup status. Normalized-path invalidation on exceptional paths should not be assumed from the current normal-failure-only rename branch.
Static plan configured owner/worker/activation/status paths must still be genuine frozen finalizer output before static dispatch.
